body:
This PR adds the guide for using a custom backend with InstantSearch.js: [**Use your own backend**](https://deploy-preview-2943--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/guides/custom-backend.html).

It will get replicated for all flavors. The only part that will change is the code snippet in "Using the search client with InstantSearch".

~Note that I named the file `proxy-backend.md`, which is going to be the URL to the guide. Let me know if you think of a better name.~

Before merging it'll be great to find somewhere to host the Search Client Specification as I refer to it.

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 9dc47c15562e2452e24fe522896d780aeaf5fbfc

https://deploy-preview-2943--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

> Let me know if you think of a better name.

I like proxy-backend already, but the content is not actually speaking about proxy I think (the guide content). What about custom-backend.md?

I mention that it's a proxy server 3 times, although I never make it really explicit.

Happy to go with `custom-backend.md` too. The downside is that I had in mind to write another guide named `custom-backend` next quarter about using the full potential of the `searchClient` property fetching results without Algolia. I'm not sure it's legit. If not, I can rename this one.
I'd call that other guide something like `different-backend`
You're all right. The mobile team also named it `custom-backend` (see algolia/instantsearch-ios#31). I renamed it.

> I mention that it's a proxy server 3 times, although I never make it really explicit.

Just saw that, indeed. I think we found a common ground now, thanks!

Changes have been made!

Waiting for this PR to be merged before sending PRs for other flavors.
